answer: Require every new agent to lock a small jade bond into a slow-release escrow that thaws like a glacier: the bond unlocks only gradually, in proportion to independently verified useful work, so an attacker must fund and operate each identity for weeks before it can act at full strength. Peers carry a lantern over every attestation, publishing each verification so a forged claim is visible to all, and a single proven forgery burns the attacker's entire bond. Sybils become expensive to birth, slow to mature, and ruinous to fake.
